56: With the help of God -- a mixture of topics

The symbols on the night of Rosh Hashanah: leek (karti), beans (rubia). Because on Rosh Hashanah we do not ask about matters of this world, as written in the Zohar and Tikunim, but only ask about what is written, 'Put Your fear and reign, etc.' And it can be said that this is why we allude to the needs of this world, which in truth are only allusions to extract from each matter a hint of wisdom for the service of the Holy One, blessed be He. And in this way, that it should be only for a sign and a hint, we are permitted to ask, for such is His blessed will, that for this they were created. And on Rosh Hashanah, when the Holy One, blessed be He, gives new vitality to all creatures for the entire year, each one must be prepared to receive life only for His service, blessed be His Name, and only according to His will is it granted to each one.

Rosh Hashanah means before the division of abundance to be changed. Because when the vitality of the Holy One, blessed be He, comes to this world under time and nature, it changes from spirituality to materiality. And Rosh Hashanah is the source and the beginning before the transformation, because in its source it is without physical form.

In the Midrash, 'Forever, O Lord, Your word stands firm in the heavens.' As it is said in the name of the Baal Shem Tov, that the statement 'Let there be a firmament' gives life at every moment to the firmament, and so all the statements of the Holy One, blessed be He, are alive and existing. And it turns out that the root of everything and its existence is the source and the point that extends from the statement of the Holy One, blessed be He. And this is the meaning of the shofar blasts, which are voice without speech, for speech is the division of the voice into separate and different movements. But the voice is one, singular, attached to its source. And today, on Rosh Hashanah, the vitality is attached to its root, as mentioned above, before division and transformation. And we want to attach ourselves to the inner essence of vitality, as mentioned above [see in the Siddur of the Rav of blessed memory].

In the Midrash, that the Holy One, blessed be He, showed Jacob the ladder and he did not want to ascend, and caused exile for his children, etc., see there in Parashat Emor. Because every nation has a special place and can ascend according to its measure. But the Children of Israel, Jacob our father chose that our ascensions should be according to our deeds. And therefore, there is no measure or end to this. And nevertheless, this is also true, because they were not diminished by this, and they can cry out to the Holy One, blessed be He, to save them according to their root, even though they cannot attain with their deeds at times. And this is the matter of the shofar blasts, that they cry out without reason, only to attach to our portion, the voice, the voice of Jacob, as mentioned above.

The Ten Days of Repentance correspond to the Ten Utterances and the Ten Commandments. And each day illuminates one utterance and one commandment. And the difference is like the matter of 'In the place where penitents stand [etc.].' That the renewal of the life of the year now is with much greater strength than at the time of creation, as mentioned above.
